reviews.review_description:
It’s been a long time since I’ve had this much fun in VR. It’s like Minecraft but with tiny cubes, and the combat is physics-based. Whenever you head out, you never know what will happen. You can fell trees and start building a house, sit around the campfire with friends and grill some food, or venture into a cave without knowing what creatures might be lurking in the dark.

It's so much fun and here’s so much to do that my friends and I are constantly getting distracted. My brother threw a bomb at some enemies but told me too late, so I got blown up too. It’s moments like these that make the game unforgettable.

What a game! I played for hours and still feel like I’ve only scratched the surface.

reviews.review_title: Way more fun than I expected
reviews.review_description: Really fun game specially with friends lol its basically Minecraft in VR but with way more physics and destruction, messing around is honestly way too addictiveee, exploring caves is prob my favorite part so far. Still early access so theres def room for improvement but yeah, been having a great time with it :D

reviews.review_title: The start of a whole new era!
reviews.review_description:
Anyone who is reading this, I guarantee you that Starworn will have you totally immersed.
If you like games like Minecraft and Terraria, you're going to absolutely love this.
I don't say this lightly. However, I do think this is my favourite game of 2026.
Even in early access, there is so much to explore, so many ways to craft weapons, armor, building materials and lots of different mobs to fight in caves in water and on land.
You can also build anything with the various materials such as wood, stone, earth and sand. Even craft useful structural components to add to your creations.

￼ amazing game I suggest downloading it. You never get bored of it. There’s so many amazing animals different types of food and many different creatures you’re able to defeat in the caves plus all the crafting that you’re able to do in the game and building. ￼

reviews.review_title: Fantastic! The perfect Minecraft for VR
reviews.review_description:
Lost hours to this one! Tearing through that world in VR is insanely satisfying. All procedural and destructible!
Multiplayer also feels fantastic and seamless,  had so many jump -scares in the caves! Not gonna spoil more!

Absolutely worth it!

Make sure you have a few hours to spare before starting to play! From exploring and discovering so many cute animals to fighting monsters, building, and having a great time around a campfire with friends, you name it you can do it!

reviews.review_title: Already a gem. Worth every penny.
reviews.review_description:
This game has so much content for the price already. The animals are crazy. The sound effects are amazing, and sometimes very silly. Jump scares WILL HAPPEN!! 

If you’re into Minecraft, or other pixel adventures, this one is an absolute must-have!!
The amount of enemy's is great there are more mobs then i expected and over all a lot of good content
Great building system and the nights are scary my friend Jackson pooped himself playing it 10\10
I enjoy my experience so far, really excited about the updates! it feels so immersive!
Quick and simple review. Addicting and fun to play.

This is what Minecraft would be like had it been made for VR from scratch! Going up and down the slopes is smooth, the combat and the crafting feel awesome and there's just a ton of content in the game. I highly recommend it!
